name: Chromophobe Renal Cell Carcinoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Urinary System and Male Genital Organs

criteria.description: Presence of large polygonal cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent cell membranes arranged in solid sheets or trabeculae
Positive staining for cytokeratin 7 and negative for CD10
Presence of numerous cytoplasmic microvesicles and characteristic cell membrane features

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with characteristic morphology plus supportive immunohistochemical profile
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for losses of chromosomes 1, 2, 6, 10, 13, 17, and 21 may aid diagnosis

common.symptomName: Flank pain localized to affected kidney

searchTerms: fatigue related to low red blood cells

occasional.symptomName: Hypertension secondary to renal mass effect
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney mass
blood pressure increase due to renal growth

rare.symptomName: Paraneoplastic Stauffer syndrome (hepatic dysfunction without liver metastasis)
searchTerms: liver problems without cancer in liver
abnormal liver function without liver tumors

rare.symptomName: Cushing syndrome due to ectopic ACTH production
searchTerms: excess cortisol due to abnormal ACTH

laboratory: Elevated serum calcium in paraneoplastic hypercalcemia
Anemia of chronic disease or polycythemia
Elevated erythropoietin levels in some cases
imaging: Contrast-enhanced CT showing well-circumscribed renal mass with hypovascular characteristics
MRI demonstrating characteristic signal intensity with central scar
Ultrasound revealing solid renal mass with heterogeneous echotexture
other: Histopathology revealing pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with prominent cell membranes
Immunohistochemistry positive for cytokeratin 7 and negative for CD10

distinguishingFeatures: Clear cytoplasm with rich vascular network
Benign renal tumor with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Absence of chromosomal losses typical of chromophobe RCC
Distinctive central stellate scar on imaging

redFlags: Unexplained weight loss and persistent fever
references: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Urinary System and Male Genital Organs, 5th Edition, 2022
Linehan WM, Ricketts CJ. The metabolic basis of kidney cancer. Semin Cancer Biol. 2013
